name: Gretel
source:
The Pessimistic Sister

One of famiglia Grimm's caporegimes. She's an extreme pessimist, spiteful with a fierce persecution complex and a razor-sharp tongue. Like her brother Hansel, she's quick to start a fight. Her clothes and satchel are stuffed full of hand grenades.

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/ozmafia/]English official website[/url].]
